headline: Conditional use appeal for a small residential care facility at 16 Lincoln Street.
summary: One conditional use appeal is on the agenda. It asks for approval to operate a small residential care facility for up to 16 individuals at 16 Lincoln Street.
items: Conditional use appeal CU-003721-2026 for 16 Lincoln Street, to operate a small residential care facility for up to 16 individuals, in the RN-3 Residential Neighborhood Zone
